Storage

    Before you connect

    1. Unlock your phone.
    2. Choose File Transfer / MTP in the USB prompt.
    3. Close other apps that use your phone, such as Android File Transfer or adb.

    Use Chrome or Edge. Your files stay on your device. This page does not send them to a server.
